title: 第21章 鼠目寸光坐地起价第22章 自己配置轻而易举
slug: 无敌帝祖第620章一剑杀了
content_zh:
“如此说来，想必刘家主已有打算。”
见到刘畅胸有成竹的模样，罗银知道对方必然已经想好对策。
“林家这些年在天元镇，最大的产业就是开脉液。”
刘畅双眸微微眯起，一想到刘柯惨死，他身为父亲却只能够眼睁睁看着，无法给刘柯报仇雪恨，他内心对林家都是恨意。
“开脉液？”
罗银眉头一挑。
开脉液顾名思义，就是开脉境的武者，修炼所需的灵液。
这些年以来，林家没有灵石矿脉的开采权，正是依靠出售开脉液，才能够勉强维系。
只不过这种灵液，需要二阶炼丹师才能够炼制出来。
而。
整个天元镇也只有一个二阶炼丹师朱大师，他早些年在野外寻找药材之时，被妖兽袭击，正是林明义出手救下来。
后来，朱大师炼制的开脉液，就一直由林家销售。
“莫不是刘家主，也拉拢了一位二阶炼丹师？”
想到这里，罗银瞪大眼睛，看向对面的刘畅。
在大衍皇朝，炼丹师的地位很高。
天元镇这样的小地方，能够招揽来二阶炼丹师，必然是付出了很大的代价。
“罗兄说笑了，二阶炼丹师又不是大白菜，哪里这么好拉拢。”
刘畅忍不住回道：“只不过那位朱大师，他愿意将开脉液交给我们来销售。”
“此话当真？”
罗银闻言，顿时来了兴致。

在天元镇，开脉液就是最畅销的修炼灵液。
若是能够销售开脉液，利润也很可观，也正好可以缓解罗家的燃眉之急。
“罗兄，你觉得我有必要骗你吗？”
刘畅缓缓的道。
“刘家主，我们罗家需要做什么？”
罗银可不相信刘畅会白白将开脉液，分给罗家销售，直接开门见山的问道。
“哈哈，我就喜欢罗兄这样爽快的性格。”
刘畅哈哈一笑，觉得和聪明人说话就是简单，当即开口道：“我给朱大师开脉液的价格是30块下品灵石一瓶。”
罗银眉头顿时拧起来。
目前天元镇林家销售的开脉液，出售价格仅仅是25块下品灵石。
现在刘畅直接出30块下品灵石一瓶，比林家的销售价格都高出了5下品灵石，也难怪朱大师会心动。
content_en:
"That being said, Master Liu must have a plan."
Seeing Liu Chang's confident look, Luo Yin knew that the other party must have already thought of a countermeasure.
"The Lin family's biggest industry in Tianyuan Town these years has been pulse opening liquid."
Liu Chang narrowed his eyes slightly. When he thought of Liu Ke's tragic death, as a father, he could only watch helplessly and could not avenge Liu Ke. He hated the Lin family in his heart.
"Pulse opening solution?"
Luo Yin raised his eyebrows.
As the name suggests, the Kai Mai Liquid is the spiritual liquid needed for martial artists in the Kai Mai Realm to practice.
Over the years, the Lin family has not had the mining rights to the Lingshi veins, and has been able to survive by selling the vein-opening liquid.
However, this kind of spiritual liquid requires a second-level alchemist to refine it.
and.
There is only one second-level alchemist Master Zhu in the entire Tianyuan Town. When he was looking for medicinal materials in the wild in the early years, he was attacked by a monster, and it was Lin Mingyi who rescued him.
Later, the pulse-opening liquid refined by Master Zhu has been sold by the Lin family.
"Could it be that the head of the Liu family has also roped in a second-level alchemist?"
Thinking of this, Luo Yin widened his eyes and looked at Liu Chang opposite.
In the Dayan Dynasty, alchemists had a very high status.
For a small place like Tianyuan Town to be able to recruit a second-level alchemist, it must have paid a heavy price.
"Brother Luo is joking. The second-level alchemist is not a cabbage. How can he be so easy to win over?"
Liu Chang couldn't help but reply: "It's just that Master Zhu, he is willing to hand over the pulse opening liquid to us for sale."
"Is this true?"
Luo Yin suddenly became interested when he heard this.
In Tianyuan Town, Pulse Opening Liquid is the best-selling spiritual cultivation liquid.
If the Pulse Opening Liquid can be sold, the profit will be considerable, which can also alleviate the Luo family's urgent needs.
"Brother Luo, do you think I need to lie to you?"
Liu Chang said slowly.
"Master Liu, what do our Luo family need to do?"
Luo Yin didn't believe that Liu Chang would give the pulse-opening liquid to the Luo family for sale in vain, so he asked straight to the point.
"Haha, I just like Brother Luo's cheerful character."
Liu Chang laughed, thinking that it was easy to talk to smart people, and immediately said: "The price of my pulse-opening fluid for Master Zhu is 30 yuan for a bottle of low-grade spiritual stones."
Luo Yin's brows suddenly wrinkled.
The current price of the pulse-opening liquid sold by the Lin family in Tianyuan Town is only 25 low-grade spiritual stones.
Now Liu Chang directly sells a bottle of low-grade spiritual stones for 30 yuan, which is 5 lower-grade spiritual stones higher than the Lin family's sales price. It's no wonder that Master Zhu is tempted.
